title: Police Bodycam Shows Suspect Hiding Inside Hollow Dresser
description:
** (Disclaimer: This video content is intended for educational and informational purposes only) **
Pasco County Sheriff’s Office deputies recently found a suspect hiding in an unusual place, a hollowed-out bedroom dresser. A deputy’s body camera was recording video when deputies entered Jason Taylor’s home in Pasco County. A felony warrant had been issued for Taylor’s arrest. He was wanted for violation of probation in connection with a charge of robbery with a deadly weapon.

After deputies went inside the home, one deputy found Taylor hiding in a hollowed-out dresser. The deputy’s body camera recorded him as he jumped out of the dresser. Taylor was arrested and is being held on a $50,000 bond. The Pasco County Sheriff’s Office on Monday released video of Taylor’s arrest.
